 Tobe Awaka (knee) probable for Friday 
 by Leo Sells | Bulls Correspondent | Thu, Oct 22nd 2026, 4:37pm EDT 
 Tobe Awaka (knee) is probable for Friday's game against the Milwaukee Bucks. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Awaka was able to play in the team's season opener on Wednesday, and he is expected to do so again on Friday, despite being on the injury report with a knee issue. He isn't expected to be a worthwhile fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however.
